name: strength-meter
title: Strength meter
description: A four-segment strength bar with a word for the level and the one thing to fix next, for passwords and other scored input.
docs: Hand it the 0 to 4 score of whichever estimator you use (zxcvbn's fits as it is) and an optional hint. Point your field's aria-describedby at the id. labels takes the five words for another language. A change is announced politely once it has held still for 800 ms. It stands alone from a password rules checklist, and the two can sit together.
